popCulture.title: Iliad II (Catalogue of Ships)
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer’s Menestheus — son of Peteos — leads fifty Athenian ships, unmatched in marshalling chariots and shield-men save Nestor alone. The Catalogue’s Athenian captain.

popCulture.title: Menestheus
popCulture.description: King of Athens after Theseus’ exile in later myth — the Iliadic marshal who, in some tellings, holds the city until the Aeacids return.
